name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the user's question or request.

name: Accuracy
description: The accuracy and correctness of the information provided in the response.

name: Completeness
description: The extent to which the response provides a complete and thorough answer to the user's question or request.

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and understandability of the language used in the response.

name: Engagement
description: The level of engagement and interaction with the user, including follow-up questions and providing additional helpful information.

name: Empathy
description: The level of empathy and understanding shown towards the user's situation and emotions.
